carry.ask: Carry {0} ({1}) to {2}? Every file is copied and checked, the original is removed, and a junction is left where it was.
carry.ask.backups: A junction is followed by everything that opens a path, but not every backup tool copies what is behind one. Check yours covers the new place.
carry.back.done: {0} is back where it was, and the carried copy is removed.
carry.description: Moves a folder to a drive with room, checks every file, and leaves a junction behind so every path that pointed at it still works.
carry.done: Carried {0} to {1}. The junction is in place.
carry.done.left: Carried {0}, and the junction is in place, but the original could not be fully removed. What is left is at {1}.
carry.failed.changed: The folder changed while it was being copied. The copy was removed and nothing changed.
carry.failed.inuse: Something has a file in it open, so the original could not be moved aside. The copy was removed and nothing changed. Close what is using it and try again.
carry.failed.link: The junction could not be made. Everything was put back as it was.
carry.failed.link.left: The junction could not be made and the original could not take its name back. Nothing was deleted: the original is at {0}.
carry.failed.notlinked: That folder is no longer a junction, so there is nothing to bring back.
carry.failed.other: It stopped at {0}. Nothing was deleted.
carry.failed.other.left: It stopped at {0}. Nothing was deleted; a copy is at {1}.
carry.failed.room: There is not enough room on the original drive to bring it back.
carry.failed.stopped: Stopped. The copy was removed and nothing changed.
carry.fixedonly: Only fixed drives are offered. A USB drive, a network share or a disc will not be there every time the computer starts, and a junction pointing at it would lead nowhere.
carry.glance: {0} folders carried, {1} moved off their drives
carry.how: How it goes: the copy goes into a folder with a temporary name, every file is read back and compared, the original is measured again in case it changed, the original is renamed aside (which fails if anything has a file in it open), the junction is made and checked, and only then is the original removed. Any step failing puts everything back as it was.
carry.refused.cloud: It holds OneDrive files that are only in the cloud. Copying them would download them, and a junction under OneDrive breaks its sync.
carry.refused.islink: This folder is already a junction or a link, most likely one Carry left. Bring it back first if it should move again.
carry.refused.links: It holds a junction or link of its own, which a copy cannot carry faithfully.
carry.refused.notfixed: That drive is removable, a network share or a disc.
carry.refused.notthere: That folder, or that drive, is not there.
carry.refused.overlaps: The destination is inside the folder, or the folder inside the destination.
carry.refused.protected: This folder is never carried: a drive's root, Windows, Program Files, ProgramData, AppData, Users or a profile itself. A folder inside one of them can be.
carry.refused.room: It needs {0} and a little more; that drive has {1} free.
carry.refused.samedrive: That is the drive it is already on.
carry.refused.unreadable: Part of it cannot be read, so it cannot be copied whole.
carry.standing.missing: the junction leads nowhere: its drive or copy is gone
carry.status.ready: Pick a folder, then a drive with room.
carry.title: Carry
